name: copilotkit
summary: I successfully completed all the quickstart code steps: created the Next.js app, installed `@copilotkit/react-core`, `@copilotkit/react-ui`, and `@copilotkit/runtime`, set up the `/api/copilotkit` route with `BuiltInAgent`, wrapped the layout in `CopilotKit`, and added `CopilotSidebar` to the page. TypeScript type-checking passes cleanly (`npx tsc --noEmit` exited 0). The dev server starts and the API endpoint is reachable—I demonstrably got a `400 POST /api/copilotkit` response, meaning the CopilotRuntime processed the request. However, the frontend hangs indefinitely at `○ Compiling / ...`, and every curl to `http://localhost:3000` times out with HTTP 000, so I could not verify the full promised outcome of a working, servable app. The blocker appears to be Next.js 16/Turbopack getting stuck during client-side compilation, likely due to resource or compatibility issues with the CopilotKit packages.
